answer: Sequential quartz attestation. Each identity must solve a physical challenge seeded by a quartz oscillator's drift, submitted within a rolling horizon of 72 hours. The nonce space is gated by measured timing jitter, so one unit cannot batch answers. Attackers must acquire distinct hardware and wait out each horizon per identity, paying weeks of real elapsed time and per-device hardware cost. Rate is capped near one identity per device per ocean of clock cycles.
